description.defaultvolume: Volume applied to new tracks; adaptive loudness uses it as the reference gain.
description.defaultautoplay: Start autoplay as soon as the queue runs out.
description.defaultrepeat: Loop mode for a new session: off, current track, or whole queue.
description.defaultshuffle: Shuffle the queue when the session starts.
description.searchtype: Lavalink search prefix used by slash commands, for example dzsearch, ytsearch, ytmsearch, or scsearch. Prefix commands use PREFIX_SEARCH_ENGINE.
description.maxqueue: Upper bound on tracks waiting in the queue.
description.maxuserqueue: Queue slots reserved for each member.
description.voteskip: Let members start a vote to skip the current track.
description.voteskippercent: Share of listeners that must agree before a vote-skip passes.
description.autocorrect: Run the closest command when a prefix command is mistyped.
description.volumeautomatic: Measure track loudness and steer volume toward the target LUFS.
description.loudnesstarget: Target integrated loudness in LUFS; -16 suits most music.
description.autoplaysource: Where autoplay starts: Deezer chart, curated seeds, or the legacy seed value.
description.autoplayseeds: Comma-separated search phrases used by the curated autoplay source.
description.announce: Post a text message when a track starts.
description.ephemeral: Make slash replies private. Disable for normal public replies; prefix replies are always public.
description.announcechannel: Text channel ID for the extra announcement. Leave blank to skip it.
description.deleteafter: Seconds before replies are removed. 0 keeps them.
description.maxtracklength: Reject tracks longer than this many seconds. 0 turns the check off.
description.mintracklength: Reject tracks shorter than this many seconds. 0 turns the check off.
description.maxusertracks: Most tracks one member may queue. 0 turns the check off.
description.maxusertrackslength: Longest total duration one member may queue, in seconds. 0 turns it off.
description.maxplaylisttracks: Most tracks accepted from a single playlist. 0 turns the check off.
description.maxplaylistlength: Longest total duration accepted from a playlist, in seconds. 0 turns it off.
description.timeoutlisteners: Disconnect after this many seconds without listeners. 0 disables.
description.timeoutpause: Disconnect after this many seconds paused. 0 disables.
description.timeoutplaying: Disconnect after this many seconds with nothing queued. 0 disables.
description.timeoutconfirmation: Ask “Still listening?” after this many seconds. 0 disables.
description.locked: Only server managers may change settings or run commands while locked.
description.dashboardvoicechannel: Voice channel ID the bot joins for browser-only playback. Blank uses the host DASHBOARD_VOICE_CHANNEL_ID fallback.
description.dashboardvoicepriority: When Dashboard browser playback is active, a Discord user’s play command clears that queue and moves the bot to their voice channel. Disable to keep browser playback in place.
description.audiotapallowall: Allow every member of this server to listen to dashboard audio. When disabled, only the listed roles, owner, and administrators may listen.
description.audiotaproles: Comma-separated Discord role IDs allowed to listen when “Allow all members” is disabled. Invalid entries are ignored.
description.commandchannel: Only accept commands in this text channel ID. Blank accepts every channel.
description.voicechannel: Require callers to sit in this voice channel ID. Blank removes the requirement.
description.disabledcommands: Comma-separated command names disabled in this server.
